## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] If a tool was added or its description changed: an `evals/prompts.yaml`
      case exists and `make evals` passes
- [ ] If third-party code was adapted: a `# THIRD-PARTY:` marker is present and
      `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` has a matching entry
- [ ] If a dependency was added: it is permissively licensed, ships wheels for
      Linux/macOS/Windows on x86-64 and ARM, and is recorded in
      `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`
- [ ] If behaviour changed: `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`
